context.title: The sector today
context.body: The Kingdom's giga-projects are building new cities, resorts and industrial zones at a scale few places have attempted. Sites change every week, span huge areas and involve hundreds of contractors.

challenges.title: Progress visibility
challenges.body: Reports lag behind what is actually built on site.

challenges.title: Quality assurance
challenges.body: Concrete and structural issues found late are costly to fix.

challenges.title: Site security
challenges.body: Large, open perimeters with valuable equipment and materials.

useCases.title: Drone progress tracking
useCases.body: Regular aerial surveys compared against plan and BIM models.

useCases.title: Smart concrete monitoring
useCases.body: Temperature and strength sensors during curing.

useCases.title: Autonomous perimeter patrols
useCases.body: Drone docking stations for continuous site surveillance.

useCases.title: Site connectivity
useCases.body: Network and communications that grow with the site.

vision2030.body: Giga-projects are flagship Vision 2030 initiatives for tourism, quality of life and economic diversification.
